implementation.procedureAnchor: Agent procedure: translate the requested structure change into an ordered, reviewable Atomsk operation.
implementation.outputAnchor: Return the exact command, read/write paths, assumptions, and structural validation checklist.
implementation.failureAnchor: Stop when crystallographic conventions, species mapping, units, or transformation order are ambiguous.

implementation.usageAnchor: Use the user-preinstalled atomsk executable only after the exact command and file effects have been reviewed.
implementation.authorityAnchor: The user owns the Atomsk installation and local files; an existing path may be replaced only after explicit confirmation.
implementation.failureAnchor: If atomsk is unavailable or rejects an option, inspect local version help and revise the command without installing software or guessing syntax.

implementation.procedureAnchor: Agent procedure: validate atom count, species, cell vectors, orientation, periodicity, coordinates, and target format after execution.
implementation.outputAnchor: Return the validation evidence and identify every intentional structural change.
implementation.failureAnchor: Treat unexplained atom loss, cell change, overlap, or format mismatch as failure.
